# AI Pick Vault

> Plain-words guides for running AI on your own Windows PC on a budget (Ollama, RAM/VRAM, budget GPUs, mini PCs, setup) and a gentle AI for Beginners section. Amazon Associate site (tag wethepeopl0b9-20); we do not list prices, check the retailer for current pricing.

## Start here
- [Run AI on Your Own Windows PC on a Budget](https://aipickvault.com/): Run AI like ChatGPT on your own Windows PC without a pricey workstation: what your PC can run, the cheapest upgrades and free setup guides.

## AI for Beginners
- [AI for Beginners: A Gentle, Honest Introduction](https://aipickvault.com/ai-for-beginners/): New to AI or worried about it? Plain-words guides on what AI is, privacy, free private AI with Ollama, and tools that help with vision, hearing and mobility.
- [AI for Seniors and Disabilities: Free Tools](https://aipickvault.com/ai-for-beginners/ai-for-seniors-and-disabilities.html): Honest ways AI may help with low vision, hearing loss, limited mobility, memory and dyslexia: free tools like Seeing AI, Be My Eyes and Live Captions.
- [AI on Your Phone: Private, Free and Offline](https://aipickvault.com/ai-for-beginners/ai-on-your-phone/): AI on your phone in plain words: built-in Apple Intelligence and Gemini Nano, free apps that run AI on the phone itself and offline, what phones can handle, battery and privacy.
- [Is AI Spying on Me? An Honest Privacy Guide](https://aipickvault.com/ai-for-beginners/is-ai-spying-on-me.html): An honest, plain-words AI privacy guide: what online AI companies keep, settings to turn off, and how local AI with Ollama keeps everything on your own PC.
- [What Is AI, Really? A Gentle Beginner's Guide](https://aipickvault.com/ai-for-beginners/what-is-ai.html): A plain-words guide to what AI really is, what it can and cannot do, myths vs facts about spying and takeover, and how to use it safely.
- [What Is Ollama? AI Models in Plain Words](https://aipickvault.com/ai-for-beginners/what-is-ollama.html): What Ollama is in plain words, which model does what (Llama, Qwen, Gemma, Mistral, DeepSeek), what fits 8, 16 or 32GB, and how to pick by task.

## Local AI guides
- [Local AI on Windows: Ollama Hardware & Setup](https://aipickvault.com/local-ai/): Run local AI with Ollama on a budget Windows PC: how much RAM and VRAM, best budget GPU, best mini PC, a sub-$1,000 AI PC and a step-by-step install.
- [Best Budget GPU for Ollama (2026)](https://aipickvault.com/local-ai/best-budget-gpu-for-ollama.html): Best budget GPU for Ollama on a Windows PC: RTX 3060 12GB, RTX 5060 Ti 16GB, RTX 4060 Ti 16GB and a used RTX 3090 compared by VRAM and models.
- [Best Mini PC for Local AI and Ollama (2026)](https://aipickvault.com/local-ai/best-mini-pc-for-local-ai.html): Best mini PC for running Ollama and local AI at home: Beelink SER8, GMKtec EVO-X2 and Mac mini compared on memory, model size, noise and who should skip each.
- [Best Ollama Models for 16GB RAM on Windows](https://aipickvault.com/local-ai/best-ollama-models-16gb-ram.html): The best Ollama models for a Windows PC with 16GB RAM, what not to run, and the cheapest upgrades (32GB RAM, NVMe SSD, 12GB GPU) when you outgrow it.
- [Budget AI PC Under $1,000 for Ollama](https://aipickvault.com/local-ai/budget-ai-pc-under-1000.html): Three ways to get a budget AI PC under $1,000 for local chat and coding help: buy a 32GB mini PC, upgrade the PC you own, or add a used 12GB GPU.
- [How Much RAM and VRAM for Ollama? (2026 Chart)](https://aipickvault.com/local-ai/how-much-ram-vram-for-ollama.html): How much RAM and VRAM you need for Ollama models from 4B to 70B, with a simple size chart, the 0.6GB per billion rule and the cheapest upgrade for a Windows PC.
- [Install Ollama + Open WebUI on Windows](https://aipickvault.com/local-ai/install-ollama-open-webui-windows.html): Step by step: install Ollama and Open WebUI on Windows 10 or 11, plus fixes for port conflicts, firewall, GPU drivers and Windows Defender.
- [Local AI vs Cloud AI Cost: Break-Even Calculator](https://aipickvault.com/local-ai/local-ai-vs-cloud-ai-cost.html): Is local AI worth it? ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and SuperGrok plans vs a one-time GPU upgrade, plus electricity cost and a break-even calculator.
